residual_analysis.definition: Per-call wall_s minus native_s, followed by medians. OLS native_s includes input loading and ends at the runtime snapshot; this residual includes frontend/wrapper work and post-snapshot native publication/destruction. Separate medians are not additive.
residual_analysis.interpretation: c11/16 wall and residual penalties occur in all four blocks despite faster loading and snapshot time. c13/16 loading is slower in all four blocks. c8 and PPML also have native-time penalties. No single scheduler, frontend, allocator or NUMA cause is established.
